  if (/^\d+(\.\d+)?%$/.test(text)) return `${Math.min(100, Math.max(1, parseFloat(text)))}%`;

  return '100%';
}

function faceFrameFit(landmarks, source, stage, mirrored = false, asset = {}, objectFit = 'contain') {
  if (!landmarks || !source.width || !source.height || !stage.width || !stage.height) return null;
  if (![33, 133, 362, 263, 234, 454, 10, 152].every(index => valid(landmarks[index]))) return null;

    contentHeight = source.height * factor;

    x: (stage.width - contentWidth) / 2 + (mirrored ? 1 - point.x : point.x) * contentWidth,
    y: (stage.height - contentHeight) / 2 + point.y * contentHeight
  });

class Random {
  constructor(seed) {

function shuffled(seed, values) {
  const rng = new Random(seed),
    deck = [...values];
  for (let i = deck.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = rng.next() % (i + 1);
    [deck[i], deck[j]] = [deck[j], deck[i]];
  }
  return deck;
}
function puzzleBoard(seed, rows, columns) {
  const board = Array.from({
      length: rows * columns
    }, (_, i) => (i + 1) % (rows * columns)),
    rng = new Random(seed);
  let empty = board.length - 1,
    previous = -1;
  for (let turn = 0; turn < rows * columns * 8; turn++) {
    const adjacent = board.map((_, i) => i).filter(i => Math.abs(Math.floor(i / columns) - Math.floor(empty / columns)) + Math.abs(i % columns - empty % columns) === 1 && i !== previous);
    const chosen = adjacent[rng.next() % adjacent.length];
    [board[empty], board[chosen]] = [board[chosen], board[empty]];
    previous = empty;
    empty = chosen;
  }
  if (board.every((v, i) => v === (i + 1) % board.length)) [board[empty], board[empty - 1]] = [board[empty - 1], board[empty]];
  return board;
}

    });
  }
  step(direction) {
    if (this.done) return;
    this.y = Math.max(600, Math.min(9400, this.y + direction * 110));
    if (this.tick % 6 === 0) this.bullets.push({
      x: 2450,
      y: this.y,
      dead: false
    });
    const period = Math.max(8, 45 - Math.floor(this.tick / 900) * 5);
    if (this.tick % period === 0) for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(1 + Math.floor(this.tick / 1800), 5); i++) this.enemies.push({
      id: ++this.serial,
      x: 16600 + i * 800,
      y: 800 + this.rng.next() % 8400,
      kind: this.rng.next() % 3,
      dead: false
    });
    this.bullets.forEach(b => {
      b.x += 280;
    });
    this.enemies.forEach(e => {
      e.x -= 65 + Math.floor(this.tick / 900) * 18;
    });
    for (const e of this.enemies) for (const b of this.bullets) if (!e.dead && !b.dead && Math.abs(e.x - b.x) <= 420 && Math.abs(e.y - b.y) <= 380) {
      e.dead = true;
      b.dead = true;
      this.kills++;
      this.explosions.push({
        x: e.x,
        y: e.y,
        tick: this.tick
      });
    }
    for (const e of this.enemies) if (!e.dead && this.tick >= this.invulnerable && Math.abs(e.x - 1800) < 650 && Math.abs(e.y - this.y) < 580) {
      e.dead = true;
      this.lives--;
      this.invulnerable = this.tick + 24;
    }
    this.bullets = this.bullets.filter(b => !b.dead && b.x < 17000);
    this.enemies = this.enemies.filter(e => !e.dead && e.x > -1000);
    this.explosions = this.explosions.filter(e => this.tick - e.tick < 18);
    this.tick++;
    this.done = this.lives <= 0 || this.tick >= this.config.max_duration_seconds * 30 || this.config.max_points > 0 && this.kills * this.config.points_per_unit >= this.config.max_points;
  }
}

function contentUrl(value, image = false) {
  const url = (value || '').trim();
  if (!url || /[\s\\\u0000-\u001f]/.test(url) || url.startsWith('//')) return null;
  if (image && /\/api\/prescriptions\//i.test(url)) return null;
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(url, window.location.origin);
    if (parsed.username || parsed.password) return null;
    if (!['http:', 'https:', ...(image ? [] : ['mailto:', 'tel:'])].includes(parsed.protocol)) return null;
    return url;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// Keep only the typography styles the editor exposes. Layout/URL-bearing CSS
// is excluded, so pasted HTML cannot cover the page or load CSS resources.
function safeStyle(node) {
  const source = node.style;
  const result = document.createElement('span').style;
  for (const property of ['color', 'background-color']) {
    const value = source.getPropertyValue(property);
    if (/^(#[\da-f]{3,8}|[a-z]+|rgba?\([\d.,%\s]+\)|hsla?\([\d.,%\s]+\))$/i.test(value)) result.setProperty(property, value);
  }
  if (['left', 'center', 'right', 'justify'].includes(source.textAlign)) result.textAlign = source.textAlign;
  if (['Arial', 'Georgia', 'Verdana', '"Times New Roman"', '"Courier New"', 'sans-serif', 'serif', 'monospace'].includes(source.fontFamily)) result.fontFamily = source.fontFamily;
  if (/^\d+(\.\d+)?px$/.test(source.fontSize) && parseFloat(source.fontSize) >= 8 && parseFloat(source.fontSize) <= 96) result.fontSize = source.fontSize;
  if (/^[1-3](\.\d+)?$/.test(source.lineHeight) && Number(source.lineHeight) <= 3) result.lineHeight = source.lineHeight;
  if (['IMG', 'TABLE', 'COL'].includes(node.tagName) && /^(\d{1,4}(\.\d+)?px|\d{1,3}(\.\d+)?%)$/.test(source.width)) result.width = source.width;
  if (result.cssText) node.setAttribute('style', result.cssText);else node.removeAttribute('style');
}
function sanitizeRichContent(html, {
  resolveImages = false
} = {}) {
  const fragment = dompurify__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__["default"].sanitize(html || '', {
    USE_PROFILES: {
      html: true
    },
    RETURN_DOM_FRAGMENT: true,
    ADD_ATTR: ['colwidth'],
    FORBID_TAGS: ['style', 'form', 'input', 'button', 'textarea', 'select', 'iframe', 'object', 'embed', 'base', 'link']
  });
  const container = document.createElement('div');
  container.appendChild(fragment);
  container.querySelectorAll('[style]').forEach(safeStyle);
  container.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(node => {
    const href = contentUrl(node.getAttribute('href'));
    if (!href) node.removeAttribute('href');
    if (node.getAttribute('target') === '_blank') node.setAttribute('rel', 'noopener noreferrer');
  });
  container.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(node => {
    const src = contentUrl(node.getAttribute('src'), true);
    node.removeAttribute('srcset');
    if (!src) {
      node.remove();
      return;
    }
    if (node.hasAttribute('data-align') && !['left', 'center', 'right'].includes(node.getAttribute('data-align'))) node.removeAttribute('data-align');
    node.setAttribute('src', resolveImages ? (0,_api__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__.imageSrc)(src) : src);
  });
  return container.innerHTML;
}
function hasRichContent(html) {

}
